name: Latvian road user charge (autoceļu lietošanas nodeva)
law: Autoceļu lietošanas nodevas likums, Annex 2 as worded by the amendments of 28 July 2017 (in force 22 August 2017): a time-based charge in euro for 1 day, 7 days, 30 days or a year, by maximum mass (3001-3500 kg, 3501-12000 kg, 12001 kg and over), axles (up to 3, or 4 and more, over 12 t) and EURO class (0-II, III, IV and better). The table keeps the 1-day rate. A fee, without VAT. Rebuilt from the Internet Archive's copies of these pages (2024). Annex 2 was replaced from 1 January 2025 by the law of 4 December 2024 (Grozījumi Autoceļu lietošanas nodevas likumā).

sources.title: Annex 2 was replaced from 1 January 2025 by the law of 4 December 2024 (Grozījumi Autoceļu lietošanas nodevas likumā)

vehicles: Goods vehicles and combinations from 3001 kg maximum mass
tolled_roads: The state main and regional road sections listed in Annex 1 of the law. Any use of them on a day needs that day's charge.
